hook.name: ForgeHookV4
hook.description: A swap fee-splitting hook that levies configurable buy/sell fees (up to 5% in Basic mode, 15% in Utility/Rewards mode) on each swap and distributes them to platform, creator, rewards, and utility recipients via a claim vault. Pool initialization and the initial liquidity deposit are gated by a central launch manager authorization system; liquidity removal is permanently disabled.
